topic: Cygnus X-1 and Stephen Hawking's bet
script: Cygnus X-1 was one of the first objects widely accepted as a black hole. It was found in 1964 as a powerful source of X-rays. The black hole is pulling gas off a giant blue companion star. A 2021 study found it has about 21 times the mass of our Sun. It lies roughly 7,000 light-years away. Stephen Hawking once bet it was not a black hole, and later admitted he lost.
